**Date:** {{< meta display-date >}}  
**From:** {{< meta from-address >}}  
**Manuscript Location:** {{< meta manuscript-location >}}  

My dear [Alley](../persons.html#182)
[Mrs Dennis](../persons.html#2205) and I counted up and found six babies of[ Mothers Meeting](../others.html#31)
Alice Bean
Gray
Miles
Hoskins boy
May
One other whom I cannot remember.

Now can you tell me what you would like us to do on Christmas day-?

Our parties are so many that I want you to say candidly whether it would be too much for you for us to come down, the 3 of us to midday dinner or whether we had not better eat it at home and come down directly after- What do you really think and feel about it?
I found the women had rather not have a meeting next Thursday so I put it off to the first in 1900
your affte

C M Yonge

[^1]: Plain paper, endorsed in another hand ‘Dec: 22nd 1899.’
